introduction: Pennsylvania WIC offers nutritious foods, nutrition services and breastfeeding support to eligible families. A local agency certifies participants.
description: Pennsylvania WIC offers nutritious foods, nutrition services and breastfeeding support to eligible families. A local agency certifies participants.

sections.who: Eligible groups include pregnant participants, postpartum participants for six months or twelve months if breastfeeding, infants and children younger than five. Residence, income and nutritional risk also matter.
sections.get: The assigned food package and counseling support nutrition. Caregivers can apply on a qualifying child’s behalf.
sections.docs:

  • Income or qualifying benefit records.
  • Pregnancy or child information needed for certification.
sections.apply:
1. Start a pre-application

    Use the pre-application linked on Pennsylvania WIC or call 800-942-9467.

  2. Arrange the appointment

    The county agency contacts online applicants to schedule review.

  3. Complete certification

    Ask who must attend and what records to bring.
sections.after: The online pre-application is a starting step, not benefit approval. Follow the clinic’s visit and benefit-use instructions.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Pennsylvania WIC. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Can a father apply for a child?
Eligible legal guardians can apply on the child’s behalf.
Does the online form finish enrollment?
No. The local agency arranges an eligibility appointment.
Is WIC a general grocery allowance?
It provides assigned foods and nutrition support.
